    T1.Street, 
    T1.StreetAbr,

    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T1.birthday)) - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', T1.birthday)) AS age

sql:
SELECT 
    (julianday(T1.time) - julianday(T2.time)) * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 AS time_difference_ms
FROM 
    results AS T1
JOIN 
    results AS T2
ON 
    T1.raceId = T2.raceId
WHERE 
    T1.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 1988 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix')
    AND T1.position = 1
    AND T2.position = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE raceId = T1.raceId) - 1
raw:

SELECT 
    (julianday(T1.time) - julianday(T2.time)) * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 AS time_difference_ms
FROM 
    results AS T1
JOIN 
    results AS T2
ON
